macros.token:
#set $sep = ' '
denoising.py longreads @CPUS@
## INPUTS #if $input_files.file_type == "archive" --input-archive '${input_files.input_archive}' #else --samples-names #for $current in $input_files.samples $sep'${current.samples_names.strip()}' #end for --input-R1 #for $current in $input_files.samples $sep'${current.input_R1}' #end for #end if
## AMPLICON PARAMETERS --min-amplicon-size $min_amplicon_size --max-amplicon-size $max_amplicon_size
## PRIMERS #if $is_primer_in_seq.primer_choice == "true" --five-prim-primer '$is_primer_in_seq.five_prim_primer' --three-prim-primer '$is_primer_in_seq.three_prim_primer' #else --without-primers #end if
## PROCESS TYPE #if $process_type.process == "Preprocess only" --process preprocess-only #elif $process_type.process == "Clustering Swarm" --process swarm --distance $process_type.distance $process_type.cluster_improvements.clustering_options #elif $process_type.process == "Denoising DADA2" --process dada2 --sample-inference $process_type.sample_inference #end if
## OUTPUTS --output-biom $output_biom --output-fasta $output_fasta --html $html #if $process_type.process == "Clustering Swarm" --output-compo $output_cluster_compo #end if

param.name: file_type
param.label: Input type
param.help: Sample files can be provided either as a single TAR archive or as separate files per sample (one or two files each).

param.label: TAR archive file
param.help: The TAR file containing the long reads (.fastq.gz) for each sample. Supported sequencers: PACBIO and ONT.

param.label: Long reads (.fastq.gz)
param.help: fastq file of long reads. Supported sequencers: PACBIO and ONT.

param.label: Minimum amplicon length
param.help: The minimum length of the amplicons (including primers)

param.label: Maximum amplicon length
param.help: The maximum length of the amplicons (including primers)

param.name: primer_choice
param.label: Do the sequences include PCR primers?
param.help: Indicate whether the sequences still include PCR primers. Select “Yes” if primers are present, “No” if they have already been removed.

param.label: 5' primer
param.help: Enter the 5' primer sequence. Wildcards are allowed. The sequence must be provided in 5' → 3' orientation.

param.label: 3' primer
param.help: Enter the 3' primer sequence. Wildcards are allowed. The sequence must be provided in 5' → 3' orientation.

param.label: Process type
param.help: Select the type of process to run
param.option: Preprocessing and denoising with DADA2. /!\ Only Pacbio sequencers are currently supported /!\.

param.label: Swarm distance threshold
param.help: Distance threshold used by Swarm for clustering.

param.name: clustering_options
param.label: Clustering refinement
param.help: (i) With --distance = 1, use the Swarm --fastidious option to refine clustering (recommended since FROGS 3.2). (ii) With --distance > 1, enable pre-clustering to reduce redundancy before final clustering step. (iii) Select this option to apply neither refinement nor pre-clustering.
param.option: With --distance = 1, refine clusters with Swarm --fastidious option (recommended since FROGS 3.2)
With --distance > 1, perform a pre-clustering step with FROGS --pre-clustering option

param.label: DADA2 pooling method
param.help: Choose how to consider sample prior to sample inferance
param.option: Pseudo pooling, samples will be pseudo-pooled prior to sample inference.
Independent, sample inference will be performed on each sample individually.
Full pooling, all samples will be pooled together prior to sample inference.
